title: Lacatski says the reverse engineering was semi-successful

tellings.quote: our own programs that have been successful to some extent per James Latsky saying yeah we were semisuccessful

plain: The United States' own secret efforts to take apart unknown craft and learn how they work have succeeded to some extent. That is what a guest named Dylan Borland says, passing on what he was told by a government official named James Lacatski. According to Borland, Lacatski's words were that "we were semisuccessful." If true, it would mean the government has learned something real from such craft.
